features.additionalInfo: Unlimited additional payments for variable loans and up to $10k additional repayments for Fixed home loans
Ability to Rate Lock
A digital experience through a mobile app
Split home loans
Up to 90% LVR (excluding LMI) for IO loans
Weekly, Fortnightly frequencies for all P&I loans. Monthly repayment frequency only for IO loans.
Fixed and Variable rates
Up to 95% LVR (including LMI) for P&I loans
Interest Only and P&I repayment options
Redraw of repaid principal above minimum required is available on variable rate loans

The $2000 myBOQ Refinance Cashback offer is being introduced for myBOQ applications submitted on or after Friday, 28 August 2026 until the application deadline of Sunday, 28 February 2027, and must settle within 120 days of the loan application date.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Be applying in personal name(s) with acceptable credit history – not as a company or a trust.
Be an Australian citizen or permanent resident or resident for tax purposes with an Australian residential address.
Earn a regular PAYG income (for example self-employed applicants are excluded and cannot earn a foreign income for tax purposes).
Looking to purchase a home or have an existing home loan with a residential property in Australia (any state)
Cross-Collateralisation is not supported. We can only accept single security applications.

features.additionalInfo: Unlimited additional payments for variable loans and up to $10k additional repayments for Fixed home loans
Fixed and Variable rates
A digital experience through a mobile app
Up to 95% LVR (including LMI) for P&I loans
Ability to Rate Lock
Weekly, Fortnightly frequencies for all P&I loans. Monthly repayment frequency only for IO loans.
Up to 90% LVR (excluding LMI) for IO loans
Split home loans
Redraw of repaid principal above minimum required is available on variable rate loans
Customers to pay annual fee. No loan application fee, post settlement top up fee and any loan variation fee
Interest Only and P&I repayment options

The $2000 myBOQ Refinance Cashback offer is being introduced for myBOQ applications submitted on or after Friday, 28 August 2026 until the application deadline of Sunday, 28 February 2027, and must settle within 120 days of the loan application date.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Be applying in personal name(s) with acceptable credit history – not as a company or a trust.
Looking to purchase a home or have an existing home loan with a residential property in Australia (any state)
Earn a regular PAYG income (for example self-employed applicants are excluded and cannot a earn foreign income for tax purposes).
Be an Australian citizen or permanent resident or resident for tax purposes with an Australian residential address.
Cross-Collateralisation is not supported. We can only accept single security applications.

fees.name: Annual fee
fees.additionalInfo: $295 each year, starting on the day your loan kicks off, then every year after that.  One annual fee is payable for all BOQ Plus Home Loans with the same borrower(s). The Annual Fee is payable on the settlement date or product switch date of your first BOQ Plus Home Loan, and then annually from this date. The fee will become payable under a loan when all earlier loans have been closed. It will continue to be payable annually on the same date it was payable on the previous loan.

products.name: Economy Variable Home Loan
products.description: A simple home loan doesn't mean you have to compromise on its features. With our Economy Home Loan, you'll enjoy an ongoing low variable interest rate with free redraw and flexible repayment options.

features.additionalInfo: Additional repayments - make unlimited additional repayments at any time
Loan Purpose - Owner Occupied and Investment housing
Unlimited free redraw- minimum $100.00 redraw.
Security - Residential property
Maximum LVR - 80% for both Owner Occupied and Investment purposes
Maximum loan term - 30 years
Loan Switching- switching fee applies
Minimum loan term - 1 year
Repayment frequency -Weekly, fortnightly, monthly
Repayment Options -Principal and Interest, Interest only (maximum 5 years; subject to approval)
Statement frequency - 6 Monthly
Split loans- fixed loan application fee applies

The $2000 BOQ Classic Refinance Cashback offer is being extended for applications submitted on or after Friday, 28 August 2026 until the new application deadline of Sunday, 28 February 2027, and must settle within 120 days of the loan application date. All other eligibility criteria will remain unchanged.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Be 18 years of age or older
New and existing customers for new lending only. Not available for the refinance or restructure of existing BOQ lending
Be an Australian citizen or permanent resident

fees.name: Government and other charges
fees.additionalInfo: Fees payable to third parties. Fees may include but are not limited to - Mortgage duty, Mortgage lodgement fee, Land title search fee etc. Fees may vary by state. Refer to your loan schedule for a complete list of third-party fees that apply to your account.

fees.name: Security Release Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable when we agree (at your request) to discharge a security.

fees.name: Production Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if a certificate of title or any security is required to be produced to another financial institution.

fees.name: Consent Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable whenever we give consent (following a request from you) to a change in security.

fees.name: Monthly Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Discounts may apply in some cases. Refer to your Loan schedule for details.

fees.name: Substitution of Security
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if we agree to substitution of a security for another security.

fees.name: Default Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable 10 days after a repayment date if you have not paid your repayment or any other payment in full on or before that repayment date. A further default fee is payable 10 days after the repayment date in each subsequent month until all overdue amounts are paid.
